description:
End-to-end design for the bug-report submission pipeline. Covers: where agents emit a candidate report, the queue/staging location, the approval UX (auto vs manual per user config), the channel choice (issue vs discussion — not PR for v1), the GitHub API path, rate limiting, retry/backoff, attribution injection, and how submitted items are tracked locally so users can see status.

Must integrate with: classifier (above) as the gating step, scrubber as the last step before send, and the settings surface for user preferences.

Deliverable: conclusion.md with the submitter contract, sequence diagram for the happy path, and an explicit decision on default channel for v1.
name: contribution-submitter-architecture
title: Design contribution-submitter architecture for bug reports
